name: Al Reem Biosphere Reserve
story: Al Reem Biosphere Reserve covers 120,000 hectares of northwest Qatar. Established in 2005, this inhabited area includes semi-arid desert landscapes and is home to gazelles and Arabian oryx. Due to its dense vegetation, the reserve is of great importance for the people of Qatar.
matters: The reserve is part of the World Network of Biosphere Reserves in the Arab States and helps protect native desert wildlife such as the Arabian oryx and Arabian gazelle.
